entries.summary: Mirage maps IsEnabled explicitly so browser-native date-input interaction remains deterministic across runtime hosts.
Mirage currently supports browser-native ISO date wire projection and stores Format as diagnostic metadata; full MAUI custom format breadth remains deterministic subset behavior in this wave.

Mirage does not infer IsOpen=true from raw focus events because browser focus does not reliably indicate native picker UI visibility; successful programmatic open requests are the strongest browser signal available, and close reconciliation still comes from change/blur.
